full_judgment: 4. The property in question were sold in auction for arrear rents and one Manik Sarder purchased the land in auction. Said Manik Sardar Settled the same to Gostha Bepari who executed and registered a kabuliyat on 11-1-1945 in favour of Manik Sarder in respect of the suit land and then Gostha Bepari erected dwelling houses on a part of the suit land and possessing rest of the same by cultivating various crops: One Ganga Charan Biswas filed Title Suit No. 43 of 1995 in the Sadar Munsif Court, Faridpur against Gostha Bepari and others for declaration of title and recovery of Khas possession. During pendency of that suit Gostha Bepari died leaving behind his only widow named Promoda Sundari who was substituted as his only legal heir. Promoda Sundari also contested the suit and it was ultimately dismissed. She acquired 1.92 acres of land as her life-estate. Promada Sundari lived with the help of the plaintiffs and with the income of the suit land and there was no legal necessity to sell the property and also she had no right to transfer the same. On her death, the plaintiffs have acquired the same as their reversionary right. The plaintiffs applied fire to the mouth of deceased Promoda Sundari (corpse) at the time of cremation and after 11 days they have performed her "Sraddha" ceremony.
